people.text: Jing wants to find a website that has information on local concerts. She'd like to do online music quizzes and also watch videos which teach you how to play different instruments.
Hans would like to read interviews with musicians and be able to upload videos of his band onto the website. He's also looking for adverts for second - hand guitars.
Precious would like a website where she can find out about piano lessons in her area. She also wants information on music from around the world, and reviews of artists' new recordings.
Antonio wants to read about the history of music and get advice on improving his singing skills. He'd like to find information about shops selling instruments near where he lives.
Nikoleta wants a site that focuses on very old music. She'd also like to learn how to read music, and be able to chat online with music lovers like herself.

items.label: A
items.title: allofusmusic.com
items.text: Whether you're a singer in a band or play violin in an orchestra, allofusmusic.com has what you need. If you've filmed your own recordings, why not put them on this website? You can enjoy other people's performances from many international locations, as well as videos of professional concerts.

items.label: B
items.title: musicyes.net
items.text: If you're looking for used or new musical equipment and aren't sure where to go, musicyes.net has a list of every store in the country. There are interviews with famous singers who give tips on becoming as good as they are, and articles on the development of music around the world through the centuries.

items.label: C
items.title: musician.com
items.text: A great site if you're into singing, especially opera and other traditional music. There are links to different music schools if you're looking for classes, and an excellent collection of step - by - step video guides for learning a range of instruments – you can even upload your own and teach other users!

items.label: D
items.title: deepmusic.net
items.text: If you're just starting out playing music and need help, the short, easy - to - follow clips on deepmusic.net are exactly what you need. Or pick a show in your area to see your favourite musicians performing, then upload your own review of it afterwards. Every week there's a new set of fun questions for you – text your musical knowledge!

items.label: E
items.title: musictolistento.com
items.text: Set up by the musical instrument shop of the same name, musictolistento.com has the latest news and journalists' opinions on the latest songs and albums to lists of qualified music teachers and classes all over the country for all kinds of instruments. There are also articles on a range of international bands and musicians.

items.label: F
items.title: musicmusic.net
items.text: musicmusic.net has a good section on music through history, though the information is mainly about music from before the fifteenth century. You can discuss anything related to music on the site with other fans. There's also a useful section on understanding and playing notation music.

items.label: G
items.title: musicability.com
items.text: This site is popular with musicians wanting to show their work to a wider audience. There are hundreds of videos posted by talented young bands from around the world, and even a monthly prize from the one that has been most popular. The comments added by users on each video are interesting, too!

items.label: H
items.title: songsandtunes.net
items.text: The perfect site for buying all kinds of musical instruments that people no longer want! And if you're a musician and want to show other people your work, why not film yourself or your band and post it onto the website for free? You can also read your favourite performer's answers to questions you've always wanted to ask.

explanations.6: Jing 想找有本地音乐会信息、能做在线音乐测验和观看教不同乐器视频的网站。D 网站 “deepmusic.net” 有本地演出信息，可上传演出评论，每周有音乐知识测验，符合需求。“pick a show in your area to see your favourite musicians performing... upload your own review of it... every week there's a new set of fun questions for you – text your musical knowledge!” 对应 “local concerts... online music quizzes... watch videos which teach you how to play different instruments”。
explanations.7: Hans 想读音乐家采访、上传乐队视频，找二手吉他广告。H 网站 “songsandtunes.net” 可上传乐队视频，有音乐家问答采访，有二手乐器购买信息，符合要求。“if you're a musician and want to show other people your work, why not film yourself or your band and post it onto the website... read your favourite performer's answers to questions... perfect site for buying all kinds of musical instruments that people no longer want!” 对应 “interviews with musicians... upload videos... adverts for second-hand guitars”。
explanations.8: Precious 想找本地钢琴课信息、世界音乐信息和艺术家新唱片评论的网站。E 网站 “musictolistento.com” 有各地乐器教师和课程列表，有国际乐队和音乐家文章，有最新歌曲和专辑的新闻和评论，符合需求。“lists of qualified music teachers and classes all over the country for all kinds of instruments... articles on a range of international bands and musicians... latest news and journalists' opinions on the latest songs and albums” 对应 “piano lessons in her area... music from around the world... reviews of artists' new recordings”。
explanations.9: Antonio 想读音乐史、获取提升歌唱技巧建议，找附近卖乐器商店信息。B 网站 “musicyes.net” 有几个世纪以来世界音乐发展的文章，有著名歌手给出的成为优秀歌手的建议，有全国乐器商店列表，符合要求。“articles on the development of music around the world through the centuries... interviews with famous singers who give tips on becoming as good as they are... has a list of every store in the country” 对应 “history of music... advice on improving his singing skills... shops selling instruments near where he lives”。
explanations.10: Nikoleta 想找专注于非常古老音乐、能学习识谱并与其他音乐爱好者在线聊天的网站。F 网站 “musicmusic.net” 有主要关于 15 世纪以前音乐的历史部分，有讨论区可与其他爱好者交流，有理解和演奏乐谱的有用部分，符合需求。“has a good section on music through history, though the information is mainly about music from before the fifteenth century... discuss anything related to music on the site with other fans... useful section on understanding and playing notation music” 对应 “focuses on very old music... learn how to read music... chat online with music lovers”。
